data.title: Boro: NVIDIA's Open-Source Effort For AI-Assisted Linux Kernel Development
data.description: Over the past few months NVIDIA has been developing Boro as a new AI-assisted kernel development CLI written in Rust and focused on local AI for enhancing efficiency for kernel development.
